title: BI nabs Taiwanese linked to P200-M syndicated fraud

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Immigration authorities arrested a Taiwanese national accused of leading a Manila-based fraud syndicate that allegedly swindled more than 200 Taiwanese victims out of over P200 million. The Bureau of Immigration (BI) said in a statement on Saturday that Yu Sheng Fu, 27, was arrested in Barangay Cabancalan, Mandaue City, Cebu, on Oct. 29 following a request from the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office in Manila. Citing information from Taiwan’s Criminal Investigation Bureau, the BI said Yu allegedly headed the syndicate operating in the Philippine capital.
